Peter,
Tomorrow, July 17th, marks four years since the passing of civil rights hero Rep. John Lewis. **In his honor, communities nationwide are hosting the John Lewis Day of Action.[Check here to see how you can take action in your community.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/89000380/485853189/1419345090?utm_campaign=don_aotl_redite_email_julyfun_email_20240702-AOTL-AGonTrumpRR_&refcode=don_aotl_redite_email_julyfun_email_20240702-AOTL-AGonTrumpRR_&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImUyNzc5NjhmLWNmNDMtZWYxMS04NmMzLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=q2046vkPeh1Rw9BJhp9z4BJvpPPskaC_UxUu7e7hcAE=&emci=f6ac12e1-aa43-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=e277968f-cf43-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=8431045)**
Rep. Lewis spent his life fighting for our freedom to vote. _And he knew that with the growing forces to suppress voting rights and the human dignity of marginalized communities, there is still a need for concerted action to protect it._
That’s why, in the last years of his life, Rep. Lewis championed two pieces of federal legislation to secure our democracy: the Freedom To Vote Act and the John Lewis Voting Rights Act.
These bills are still sitting in Congress waiting for the moment when our elected leaders will feel the urgency and moral clarity necessary to protect our freedom to vote.
**We know Congress will never act on the freedom to vote without a major push from communities all around the country.**
[**So we’re working with activists like you to host events nationwide tomorrow, July 17th, 2024, and highlight the importance of this moment.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/89000381/485853190/1419345090?utm_campaign=don_aotl_redite_email_julyfun_email_20240702-AOTL-AGonTrumpRR_&refcode=don_aotl_redite_email_julyfun_email_20240702-AOTL-AGonTrumpRR_&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImUyNzc5NjhmLWNmNDMtZWYxMS04NmMzLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=q2046vkPeh1Rw9BJhp9z4BJvpPPskaC_UxUu7e7hcAE=&emci=f6ac12e1-aa43-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=e277968f-cf43-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=8431045)

clean_body: We’re working with activists like you... | Peter, Tomorrow, July 17th, marks four years since the passing of civil rights hero Rep. John Lewis. In his honor, communities nationwide are hosting the John Lewis Day of Action. Rep. Lewis spent his life fighting for our freedom to vote. And he knew that with the growing forces to suppress voting rights and the human dignity of marginalized communities, there is still a need for concerted action to protect it. That’s why, in the last years of his life, Rep. Lewis championed two pieces of federal legislation to secure our democracy: the Freedom To Vote Act and the John Lewis Voting Rights Act. These bills are still sitting in Congress waiting for the moment when our elected leaders will feel the urgency and moral clarity necessary to protect our freedom to vote. We know Congress will never act on the freedom to vote without a major push from communities all around the country. Don’t see an event near you? Whether you’re an experienced event host or this is your first time organizing an event - we’ll be there every step of the way to support you. Peter,

We are now two days into the Republican National Convention, and it’s been a predictable circus side-show of right-wing extremism.

Despite calls for unity in the wake of the Pennsylvania rally shooting, Trump immediately appointed one of the most radical, fundamentalist members of our federal government as his running mate – JD Vance.

In the first 48 hours of the RNC we witnessed a parade of all the most radical right-wing voices in mainstream politics – from Donald Trump to Tom Cotton to Marjorie Taylor Greene.

Their “noxious” and “reprehensible” (JD Vance’s words, not mine) agenda would set our country back by a century or more. And what have Democrats done to answer this existential threat to our democracy?

They are insisting we line up behind the LEAST popular incumbent in history, who is currently spiraling in the polls and rapidly losing the faith of the American people because – “we have no other choice.”
**
They’re wrong. We**** _always_****have a choice.

****Each part of the agenda at the RNC is communicating a clear set of priorities. They are clearly telegraphing their intent to assault what remains of our constitutional republic. In response, Democrats are doing little more than lighting candles and hoping for the best.
**
We see that reflected in the scores of **“unnamed Democrats” who have already resigned to a 2nd Trump presidency.**

Here’s the dirty little secret: mainstream Democrats are in no way prepared to counter the open threat of Republican fascism because, on most issues, _they actually agree.

_ I’m at the RNC this week with fellow activists to confront these fascist ideologies directly, and present a message of people, planet, and peace as the way forward.

Instead the Democrats are playing coy with some of the most dangerous political actors on the American stage today, all to keep their corporate sponsors happy.

**[We reject the politics of dead-end doomer-ism and choose to fight for a future where working people can thrive.](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=rnc&n=6)**

Jill

# Melton for Iowa 2024
---
---
| Hello Peter,

This is Ryan Melton, Democrat running for the U.S. House in Iowa's 4th Congressional District. During my 2024 campaign, I'll send you a weekly email to keep you in the loop while not overwhelming your inbox. Typically, the newsletter will be a review from the week prior: Where we went, what issues of note were on the minds of those I met with, where we'll be in the next week, etc.
Where I went on the campaign trail last week: Last week, I started my county fair party booth circuit. My goal is to hit every county fair in which county Democratic parties host a booth. I: -met with the AARP in Ames to discuss legislative support for family caregivers, -attended Democratic party booths at the Buena Vista, Wright, Carroll, Marshall, and Mills County Fairs, -attended Omaha/Council Bluffs Pride to support my brother, who is trans, -and attended the Pottawattamie County Dems Fundraiser in Council Bluffs Sunday
The pressing issue on the campaign trail last week: At the Mills County Fair Democratic party booth in Malvern Saturday, I had one of my favorite conversations of the campaign with a high school senior-to be. He told me he had long wanted to ask me this question, so I wanted to be thoughtful and thorough in response. He asked:
"Considering the electoral history of this county and our district, why should we keep trying to move the needle politically?"
He didn't ask it in a hopeless, defeated way. Instead, he was looking for motivation. For inspiration. For hope.
I gave him a number of reasons why, reasons I remind myself of to keep going, to keep fighting regardless of how tired I get, regardless of how hard it is sometimes to get in the car and take that next 3 hour drive to my next event.

1. A lot more people are paying attention to what we on the front lines of the civic sphere do than we often know. With regularity, I get messages from people thanking me for fighting for them. Often, it's kids in the LGBTQ+ community, or young women who fear getting pregnant in an abortion ban state, or landowners besieged by eminent domain abuse by the corporate titans that run this state and own its politicians. They often feel left behind, but seeing advocates fighting for them help them to see where their friends are, where the light is, where their community is. They see they aren't alone, and that matters immensely.
2. By continuing to run for open offices despite the odds, we hold the powerful accountable. We force them to knock doors and attend public forums where unopposed they most certainly wouldn't. That then allows the public to better assess the incumbents and to make better voting decisions.
3. By challenging entrenched incumbents, you force them to think twice before pushing extremist or out of step legislation or policy. In '22, I forced Feenstra to go silent on his support for carbon capture pipelines after his corporate owners compelled him to write Op-Eds and social media posts in support of them in 2021, and shamed him into voting for the PACT Act to expand VA access for veterans suffering from severe illness due to their exposure to toxic burn pits and agent orange while serving when it came in front of him in the US House the second time. The first time, he voted against the bill and went on a radio show after doubling down on his opposition, but he took a lot of heat from my supporters and I after that first no vote. I also forced him to be more of a wind power advocate after I called him out for mocking our state's nation-leading wind energy sector at the private Iowa Corngrowers Association forum we both attended.
4. By challenging entrenched incumbents, you force them to spend money they otherwise wouldn't spend. Feenstra ignored me until he no longer could, first referring to me on social media in August '22 after we started gaining some momentum in the press. He ended up spending thousands on attack mailers against me, money that could have been spent elsewhere.
5. While the ultimate goal is certainly the win on election day, we can accomplish a lot of wins on specific issues in the meantime. Last legislative session in Des Moines, I protested anti-LGBTQ+ bills. I wasn't alone. Hundreds filled the Capitol in DSM numerous times protesting such bills. The legislators certainly could hear us in their committee chambers. Over 20 anti-LGBTQ+ bills went down in defeat last session despite the Republican Party's hold on both chambers and the Governor's seat. That doesn't happen unless there's robust protest to drive accountability. I also was arguably the first major candidate to campaign against the carbon capture pipelines in '22, whereas Feenstra was a public supporter of them, so much so that he wrote an op-ed in a district newspaper in December '21 at the bidding of his Summit/Rastetter donors (aka owners). When I started campaigning against them right after filing with the FEC to run in early '22, he went silent on the issue, and later started to claim he didn't talk about the issue anymore because it was a state-only issue, despite the fact it's federal tax credits that are driving these pipeline companies to steal our land for these scam pipelines, federal tax credits he wrote about positively in that Dec. '21 Op-Ed.
6. We have to build our own hope. No one's going to do it for us. We need to take pride in fighting the good fight just because it's the right thing to do. We can't give up. We can't give in. If we do, we're letting a lot of folks down who are bullied, vilified, dehumanized, otherized, robbed, and used in this state, who know the odds aren't in our favor but want to at least know there are people who love them and will fight for them.
7. Finally, I really believe we can win this thing. It was only a few cycles ago when J.D. Scholten lost the election for this seat by only 3%. Yes, it may take a lot of variables aligning in our favor to overcome our voter registration mathematical disadvantage, but I think those variables are indeed aligning for us. clean_body: | | | | == | == | Melton for Iowa 2024 | Hello Peter, This is Ryan Melton, Democrat running for the U.S. House in Iowa's 4th Congressional District. During my 2024 campaign, I'll send you a weekly email to keep you in the loop while not overwhelming your inbox. Typically, the newsletter will be a review from the week prior: Where we went, what issues of note were on the minds of those I met with, where we'll be in the next week, etc. Where I went on the campaign trail last week: Last week, I started my county fair party booth circuit. My goal is to hit every county fair in which county Democratic parties host a booth. I: -met with the AARP in Ames to discuss legislative support for family caregivers, -attended Democratic party booths at the Buena Vista, Wright, Carroll, Marshall, and Mills County Fairs, -attended Omaha/Council Bluffs Pride to support my brother, who is trans, -and attended the Pottawattamie County Dems Fundraiser in Council Bluffs Sunday The pressing issue on the campaign trail last week: At the Mills County Fair Democratic party booth in Malvern Saturday, I had one of my favorite conversations of the campaign with a high school senior-to be. He told me he had long wanted to ask me this question, so I wanted to be thoughtful and thorough in response. He asked: "Considering the electoral history of this county and our district, why should we keep trying to move the needle politically?" He didn't ask it in a hopeless, defeated way. Instead, he was looking for motivation. For inspiration. For hope. I gave him a number of reasons why, reasons I remind myself of to keep going, to keep fighting regardless of how tired I get, regardless of how hard it is sometimes to get in the car and take that next 3 hour drive to my next event. 1. A lot more people are paying attention to what we on the front lines of the civic sphere do than we often know. With regularity, I get messages from people thanking me for fighting for them. Often, it's kids in the LGBTQ+ community, or young women who fear getting pregnant in an abortion ban state, or landowners besieged by eminent domain abuse by the corporate titans that run this state and own its politicians. They often feel left behind, but seeing advocates fighting for them help them to see where their friends are, where the light is, where their community is. They see they aren't alone, and that matters immensely. 2. By continuing to run for open offices despite the odds, we hold the powerful accountable. We force them to knock doors and attend public forums where unopposed they most certainly wouldn't. That then allows the public to better assess the incumbents and to make better voting decisions. 3. By challenging entrenched incumbents, you force them to think twice before pushing extremist or out of step legislation or policy. In '22, I forced Feenstra to go silent on his support for carbon capture pipelines after his corporate owners compelled him to write Op-Eds and social media posts in support of them in 2021, and shamed him into voting for the PACT Act to expand VA access for veterans suffering from severe illness due to their exposure to toxic burn pits and agent orange while serving when it came in front of him in the US House the second time. The first time, he voted against the bill and went on a radio show after doubling down on his opposition, but he took a lot of heat from my supporters and I after that first no vote. I also forced him to be more of a wind power advocate after I called him out for mocking our state's nation-leading wind energy sector at the private Iowa Corngrowers Association forum we both attended. 4. By challenging entrenched incumbents, you force them to spend money they otherwise wouldn't spend. Feenstra ignored me until he no longer could, first referring to me on social media in August '22 after we started gaining some momentum in the press. The legislators certainly could hear us in their committee chambers. Over 20 anti-LGBTQ+ bills went down in defeat last session despite the Republican Party's hold on both chambers and the Governor's seat. That doesn't happen unless there's robust protest to drive accountability. I also was arguably the first major candidate to campaign against the carbon capture pipelines in '22, whereas Feenstra was a public supporter of them, so much so that he wrote an op-ed in a district newspaper in December '21 at the bidding of his Summit/Rastetter donors (aka owners). When I started campaigning against them right after filing with the FEC to run in early '22, he went silent on the issue, and later started to claim he didn't talk about the issue anymore because it was a state-only issue, despite the fact it's federal tax credits that are driving these pipeline companies to steal our land for these scam pipelines, federal tax credits he wrote about positively in that Dec. '21 Op-Ed. 6. We have to build our own hope. No one's going to do it for us. We need to take pride in fighting the good fight just because it's the right thing to do. We can't give up. We can't give in. If we do, we're letting a lot of folks down who are bullied, vilified, dehumanized, otherized, robbed, and used in this state, who know the odds aren't in our favor but want to at least know there are people who love them and will fight for them. 7. body:
We’ve been told our whole lives to eat certain fruits, vegetables, and whole grains to stay in good health.

We've been told our whole lives to eat certain fruits, vegetables, and whole grains to stay in good health.
However, according to Dr. Steven Gundry — a world-renowned heart surgeon — many so called **" health foods" in the American diet contain a dangerous toxin, that could be expanding your waistline.**
**" This toxin causes micro-tears to form in your fragile intestinal-wall — allowing bacteria and waste products to seep into your body."** Says Dr. Gundry.
This harmful condition is best known as "leaky gut," and it's affecting millions of people nationwide. **Warning signs include weight gain, fatigue, digestive discomfort, stiff, achy joints, and even skin problems.**
Dr. Gundry explains, "**These side effects are often mistaken for normal signs of aging, because leaky gut usually develops over a matter of years, and sometimes even decades. But I can assure you, the damage caused by these so called "health foods" is far from normal."**
The good news is, this problem can be **easily fixed from your own home.**
"It's very simple, you just have to know which foods are actually healthy, and which contain this hidden toxin," he goes on to explain.
By simply eliminating this harmful toxin, Dr. Gundry has seen thousands of his own patients make swift recoveries. (In fact, he even lost 70lbs himself!)
Now, after years of research, Dr. Gundry has decided to release an informative video to the public — free and uninterrupted — showcasing exactly which foods you need to avoid.
"Good health is one of life's toughest obstacles," he explains. "So, if this video can help people achieve that, I'll be thrilled to hear I was of help."
The video has since gone viral, first being shared by users on Facebook, then being featured on news sites like ABC and CBS.
So far, the comments and feedback have been outstanding, with thousands of Americans feeling better than they have in decades.

Dr. Gundry also serves as the personal physician to many A-list celebrities.
Most notable of which include legendary self-help guru Tony Robbins, Oscar award winning actor Alan Arkin, Grammy award winning singer Usher, and countless fortune 500 executives.
Now, there is one thing Dr. Gundry asks from his viewers: "If watching this helps you take control of your weight back, fight unwanted cravings, increase your energy, ease gas and bloating, or find relief from stiff, achy joints," Dr. Gundry says... "Then please share this video with your friends and loved ones. Together, we can help as many people avoid these health issues as possible."

In short, they aim to transform the world economy. As Klaus Schwab--the founder and executive director of the Forum--wrote, "We need a 'Great Reset' of capitalism." If successful, their plan would also have the effect of destroying our American way of life.

This initiative is not merely about economic reform. It is an attempt to impose global rule by so-called experts.

Some social media companies are censoring our efforts to promote a seminar we hosted on the Hillsdale campus that explored the topic of the Great Reset. Fortunately, we can communicate directly with you.

In this seminar, we...

Request for Volunteers
| | | |
---
VOLUNTEER NEWSLETTER
Dear Peter:
Beth Weddle, Campaign Manager, for Mark Robertson, reaching out once again to those of you who helped on the 2022 campaign and on Mark's campaign leading up to the primary. As most of you know by now, Mark won the Republican primary in Nevada's First Congressional District and now is facing off for the second time against Dina Titus in the General Election on November 5, 2024.
There are only 93 days until the General Election, and we need your HELP!
Here is what we need:
* Volunteer Coordinator: This is an important job that requires a few hours of your time each week. This volunteer would maintain our volunteer database and provide reports and lists to campaign staff members for various campaign activities (marketing, fundraising, GOTV, texting, door knocking, telephoning, texting, etc.) * Social Media Guru: This volunteer will help Mark get seen on social media sites. Possibly teach volunteers how to spread the word on Facebook, Instagram, etc. * Sign Volunteers: We need people in various parts of CD1 to store a few signs at their home and deliver them to homes as needed. * Walkers to distribute campaign literature in your neighborhood (or other neighborhoods as needed, if you are able). We will provide you the materials and a list of homes. We may also have some "group" walks where we meet in a specific location and walk together. * Phone callers to make calls to voters. You will be provided a script. We plan to use a phone-calling app, and nine times out of ten, you will push a button and leave a voicemail.
In order for Mark to beat Dina Titus and get elected to Congress in the fall, we need a large group of volunteers. If you are willing to help Mark get elected, please just reply to this email or phone me, Beth Weddle, 702-526-5934, [Beth@RobertsonForCongress.com](mailto:Beth@RobertsonForCongress.com). I would love to speak with you and discuss how you might be able to help!
Sincerely,
Beth Weddle Campaign Manager Robertson For Congress 702-526-5934 [Beth@RobertsonForCongress.com](mailto:Beth@RobertsonForCongress.com)

## Democrats Push to Stop Virtual Biden Vote
Over 20 House Democrats have called for the Democratic National Committee to [delay the imminent](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0DGP4yAQBeBfY3dEMIw9oaC4Jl2uvdLCMCScMFiYdbT_fpXU272n13x6_-7L3aWcyuOv29j2WBfnezp5IaFIAC44BhuZgfXIVhEoAD0RjE-LUc_SkVvBXMGbiYzRXs_gUAVSwGOyIAElKVJSKq0us5ZhCpPxRBqvAANKDqnXdvlfU-lPjvm7ntwuvm5jts_e92PQfwa4DXBze-HX8Z7epfXkMw9wW1PgIgJv1TfXD9Hb17aLxpzZ91SL8LWcXD7xzRHGhHX2Tq4UIqgJEVaKXsUAGBFnPTYb9lfKOR0zDSgfm0v5I-q__3Na-AkAAP__owNl1A) virtual roll call nomination of President Biden, which could otherwise happen as soon as Sunday. In a letter to the DNC, the House member said serious concerns remain about Biden's place at the top of the ticket. Three former chairs of the DNC are [resisting the call to delay](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFu5CAQgOGnwR0WDNisC4qTTu72dF1Ki2XGu5NgWGHild8-SurUf_Pre7su18CJ8_1f2Mi3tSwhNj5ocVI7CXaxHfqVCMh05LUDDWAGB93Da-NwnFZHFzdNN8A1XhDVNNhAGEcdO_agwCqnnVZKG92PRuGAwxSdM_YCIKwi5FZq_144twet6SwH1T6WrUv-0dpzF-aPgFnAHG4x02vv7-U7C5j_l8SN4y5gRtpKrKFxlCm8tvBBdZcxpCSfobZTIqVwyoNr-wxJ3hgpy1w2zqFxyQLmvZV6CjMzCvNXaz1No4Whqx6fL06J99EJq-5b4PQz136nOjx8BQAA___VzWxc), sending letters to committee members urging them to approve the virtual vote. A few years ago, members of the world's elite met at the annual World Economic Forum in Davos, Switzerland, and launched the Great Reset initiative.

What is their plan, and what does it mean for America?

In short, they aim to transform the world economy. As Klaus Schwab--the founder and executive director of the Forum--wrote, "We need a 'Great Reset' of capitalism." If successful, their plan would also have the effect of destroying our American way of life.

This initiative is not merely about economic reform. It is an attempt to impose global rule by so-called experts.

Some social media companies are censoring our efforts to promote a seminar we hosted on the Hillsdale campus that explored the topic of the Great Reset. Fortunately, we can communicate directly with you.

In this seminar, we...
* Consider the idea of the Great Reset and its implications for America.
* Explore how the ideology of "woke capitalism" is infiltrating large corporations.
* Delve into pro-freedom alternatives to this tyrannical plan.

I want to take a moment to remind you of my journey to the U.S. Senate, the important le ssons I have learned along the way, and why I continue to believe wholeheartedly in our beloved state.

My father, a World War II veteran, left school during the Great Depression to join the Army. Though he only had a ninth grade education, he built a career as a hard-working cement finisher. My mother, a dedicated voter who never missed an election, instilled in me the importance of civic duty.

From my parents, I inherited an unwavering love for this country that I have proudly carried throughout my life. It's something I strive to keep alive in Wyoming.

Later, in medical school, I learned the importance of having a plan before taking action, a lesson that has proven invaluable in both my medical career and my service as your senator. Just as in surgery, effective leadership requires a clear vision and a strategic approach to problem-solving.

As you may know, I am sometimes referred to as _"Wyoming's doctor,"_ but to be honest, that is what I have always strived to be as your senator. I have wholeheartedly dedicated myself to serving the state, addressing its challenges, and making it the best it can be.

**_Whether it's advocating for our veterans, championing American energy security, or safeguarding our borders, I've always strived to be a voice for all Wyoming people. Your concerns are my concerns, and your aspirations are my aspirations._**

As we look towards the future, I'm confident that Wyoming has the potential to be an even stronger, more prosperous state. **[But it will require strong leadership, a clear vision, and your continued support.](http://links.gopmembership.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=e1897658f7b842ba81a861261ff195fb&_e=q6noNG2xbZzztRuZMhD_PWHSZMBV5zLfrPk-WZ5aSfYkcexBZfHWwV7iQzmrQMD_4q1KEJ5dognqUBKoRG7F3iVFXknCKxIxXgsh9zETvshlq99s2UnePxHQ6JLXxAZQ9l8CQG-05NiNAH41EBMgrh22fpkCYYW0UuERLjG9JDq-0m_sHMaThT01xOFjdNzaEH0NSIHaBGbO3_VsOSjkNNc2WC42lIgFnxD5cX8ZGPZ3sLQG9lwhTfRup94OhLC2hcv4Y2uraCNxeLW4b67MYg%3D%3D)**

Already, your support has been instrumental in my journey, and I promise to continue fighting for the issues that matter most to Wyoming families.

Sincerely,
Senator John Barrasso [CHIP IN FOR A STRONG WYOMING](http://links.gopmembership.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=e1897658f7b842ba81a861261ff195fb&_e=q6noNG2xbZzztRuZMhD_PWHSZMBV5zLfrPk-WZ5aSfYkcexBZfHWwV7iQzmrQMD_4q1KEJ5dognqUBKoRG7F3iVFXknCKxIxXgsh9zETvshlq99s2UnePxHQ6JLXxAZQDzATNdzy1RNeGRv4k7Gw6oNrZZEeFAywTLva4HmLi6ISkNn4ImrZJk7MbutZP2iHBmjdz-PREqnv3gIloqKBsgo7p69zF2pS56kT-0_iDFe7Jy9-6g02UFGD5OOTkYHJyHRe51WMSIGNfuQ7eyWAZQ%3D%3D)

Hi Peter,
I'm thrilled to share some fantastic news with you. Our campaign was the ONLY one in the second congressional district to be recommended by the Mainstream Coalition.
The Mainstream Coalition, established in 1993 in response to growing extremism in Kansas politics, has been a steadfast advocate moderation and bipartisanship. Through dedicated lobbying, public education campaigns, and grassroots organizing, the Mainstream Coalition has played a crucial role in shaping public policy and elections, ensuring that the voices of moderation and progress are heard and valued.
We are honored to receive their recommendation, which underscores Matt’s dedication to the same common sense values the Mainstream Coalition has long championed.

Donald Trump has selected J.D. Vance for Vice President - and _Forbes_ reports that Project 2025’s architects are THRILLED.
Heritage Foundation president Kevin Roberts says he was “really rooting” for Vance’s selection and called him “a man who personifies hope for our nation’s future.”
Vance has explicitly endorsed one of Project 2025’s most dangerous plans replace thousands of career civil servants with red-hatted Republican Party political cadres who will rubber-stamp Trump’s agenda.

# The Battle to Flip Texas Blue.

My name is Laura Jones and I am running for Congress in Texas’s 8th District.
As a mom, a business owner, and a born-and-raised Texan, I know that real representation starts with having a voice from one of us, not a career politician.

My campaign and winning a seat in the United States Congress will be instrumental in achieving better representation for our communities and flipping Texas BLUE.

[**In a moment, I’m going to explain why running is so important to me, but if you’re ready to flip Texas blue and win for the 8th district, chip in today!** ](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=13749a9dd7&e=a2a46ff12c)
---
[](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=725fa93d60&e=a2a46ff12c)
| **Some things you may not know about me:**

I served as the Chair for the San Jacinto County Democrats and Field Director for Texas Senate District 3 under the Texas Democratic Party's Non-Urban Rural Caucus.

I was born and raised in Houston, Texas, where my Husband and I raised our 6 children and operated a successful business.

I fell in love with the peace and tranquility of rural Texas. So a few years ago, my husband and I built a home with our two youngest children here.

However, I immediately noticed the lack of proper representation. As Field Director, I traveled around East Texas talking to residents, and I heard many times that they felt as if their voices were not heard. Many issues have gone unresolved for decades, and we now face real challenges with our healthcare, public education, the climate crisis, and job security in many rural Texas communities.

As a tax-paying resident and mother of children attending a rural community's local schools, I could not just sit back and allow things to decline. And so I am running to be a part of the change that we desperately need in our community.

I am ready to be one of us for all of us.

[**If you’re ready to be a part of our campaign and see that we have the momentum needed to flip Texas, please chip in today. It would mean the world to me.**](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=89eaf93641&e=a2a46ff12c)

name: Heidi Ganahl
subject: The Mountain Minute: 7/17/2024
body:
Your daily rundown of REAL news for REAL Coloradans.
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi friends!
What an incredible day and night we’ve had at the Republican National Convention! Team RMV is buzzing with excitement after witnessing the incredible spirit of camaraderie and unity among Republicans from all corners of the country. It’s heartwarming to see everyone so energized and united, sharing smiles and engaging in friendly, passionate conversations about the future of our nation.
We truly feel like a family here, united by our common values and dedication to preserve the freedom and prosperity that make this country great. It’s days like these that remind us of the strength and positivity that come from being part of such an amazing community.
Let’s carry this energy forward!
This is the Mountain Minute for Wednesday, July 17, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl, from the Republican National Convention in Milwaukee
---
|
---
| | **TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
---
**[‘The devil came’ but ‘the lion roared’, Sen. Tim Scott says in energizing address to RNC](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_Until former President Donald J. Trump arrived in the arena Monday, the most applause on the opening night at the Republican National Convention in Milwaukee, Wisc., was reserved for one of his primary opponents, Sen. Tim Scott of South Carolina._
_Scott has been described by Mr. Trump as a better campaigner for the former president than for himself. That certainly seemed to be the case Monday._
_“If you didn’t believe in miracles before Saturday, you better be believing now,” said Scott, who in moments of a short address to delegates seemed more like a minister and less like a politician. “Our God still saves, still delivers and still sets free. On Saturday, the devil came to Pennsylvania holding a rifle, but the lion got back up on his feet and he roared.”_

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**MANDY CONNELL ON THE STREET AT THE RNC**
**[07-16-24 FULL SHOW - Day Two From The RNC, Plus Trump Is Different](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)[]()** [THE MANDY CONNELL PODCAST](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
**[LISTEN HERE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[7/16/24 Blog: Day Two From The RNC, Plus Trump Is Different](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)[]()** [THE MANDY CONNELL PODCAST](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_HOLY COW THAT WAS A LOT YESTERDAY Day one of the convention was VERY eventful as not only did President Trump announce that Ohio Senator JD Vance is his running mate but he made an appearance at the convention last night to sit with family and friends. The welcome was overwhelming from the Republicans in the FiServ Forum but Trump was not his same over the top self. He seemed grateful and humbled to me, and Arod said he sort of seemed embarrassed by all the cheering. What did you see in him last night?_ **[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**RNC COVERAGE**
**[Ganahl: A look at J.D. Vance, Trump’s vice-presidential candidate, a Marine veteran and first Millennial on a major-party ticket](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)[]()** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). COMMENTARY
* Former President Donald Trump selected Senator J.D. Vance as his vice-presidential running mate, marking Vance as one of the youngest and the first Millennial on a major-party ticket.

* Vance's journey from a challenging upbringing in Ohio to a U.S. Senator is chronicled in his bestselling memoir "Hillbilly Elegy," influencing his populist conservative stances.

* Known for his alignment with Trump's ideology, Vance promotes a pro-worker agenda and holds critical views on foreign policy issues like U.S. involvement in Ukraine and relations with China

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Suspect wielding knives shot dead ‘in the back’ by cops near RNC: sources, witnesses say](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)[]()** [NEW YORK POST,](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) COMMENTARY
* A homeless man known as "Sam," reportedly hearing voices, was fatally shot by police near the Republican National Convention in Milwaukee.
* Witnesses claim Sam was fleeing and not threatening police when shot in the back; at least eight shots were fired by several officers.
* The shooting, near the high-security convention site following an assassination attempt on Trump, is not believed to be directly related to the event.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**STATE AND LOCAL**
**[Having called Trump ‘the devil’ and facing calls to resign, state Rep. Steven Woodrow calls his post ‘inarticulate’](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Colorado state Rep. Steven Woodrow apologized for a tweet calling Donald Trump "the devil" following an assassination attempt on the former president, acknowledging the comment was inarticulate and caused additional pain.
* Woodrow's tweet received widespread condemnation from both Democrats and Republicans, leading to his deletion of his social media account
* Political leaders across the spectrum criticized the tweet as inappropriate, emphasizing the need for respectful political discourse and condemning threats against Woodrow following his comment.

|
---
**[Denver voters will decide whether to allow non-citizens to serve as police, firefighters](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [DENVER GAZETTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The Denver City Council approved a ballot measure allowing non-citizens with legal status to apply for police and firefighter roles, pending voter approval.
* This proposal aligns Denver with federal anti-discrimination laws and broader trends in other states where lawful residents can serve in law enforcement.
* Denver's police and fire chiefs support the measure, which now awaits the decision of Denver voters in November.

|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️**
**[Platform focuses on ‘forgotten men and women of America’, Sen. Blackburn reports](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY BRIAN PORTER | COMMENTARY | JULY 16** []() _U.S. Sen. Marsha Blackburn, R-Tenn., reported to delegates and attendees Monday evening at the Republican National Convention in Milwaukee, Wisc., that under her leadership the party has a simple to understand platform._
**[Fabbricatore: A law enforcement leader’s perspective on the assassination attempt on President Trump](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY JOHN FABBRICATOR | COMMENTARY | JULY 15** _Have you ever experienced a situation where things happen that are done right, but still go horribly wrong? The recent assassination attempt on President Donald Trump’s life is a stark example of this._
**[Griswold calls for recount in House District 58 Republican primary race decided by three votes](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY BRIAN PORTER | STATE | JULY 15** _Three votes. That’s how close the Colorado House District 58 Republican primary race was between Larry Don Suckla and Mark Roeber._

|

name: Paul Hudson
subject: Friend, America Has a Choice to Make
body:
An assassin’s bullet missed by an inch this weekend, but as a nation we inched toward the abyss. Where we go from here is a choice.
| | |
---
| [](https://5hqec7gbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001Tfgw0QcECu-3bXSSo7_4rdO3L2Cfm-LW3V4dunsNuT0WuvV-X2NlK5nlD2RlcWZEJb8iznPeTd6mHocUlQ1Byj5l05Gc3XuQNNDGGRnfuClN-e4e4GfBz7sIXcCpiwDVLXCHE61vhujI62sSkwvI5Mh37fy5COLjH0bU-7zSHDg=&c=vOWl13MtFrDks_R_Lp9ubnndvqKsHrHHXISKddLFGC2Vdj5rDRdCaQ==&ch=WM3Iqo1c2pTMrt99r-q52vA9ZhOd7Z2ERhgszF_LUHEuZWxtLCgleg==)
---
|
Friend
An assassin's bullet missed by an inch this weekend, but as a nation we inched toward the abyss.
---
| Where we go from here is a choice. As a candidate for Congress, I think we have a responsibility to stop the dangerous rhetoric that has gotten us here. Politics are white hot right now, and the last thing we need is more gas on the fire.
Our political culture is toxic. Political rhetoric is apocalyptic. We're told every election is the most important of our lifetime, a battle of good and evil with our very democracy and way of life on the line. When those are the supposed stakes, it's little surprise when violence ensues.
---
|
---
|
As a candidate, I've seen the spiral of ugliness firsthand. Death threats. Casual calls to imprison and execute political opponents for treason. A quick trip to the comments section of any run-of-the-mill political post is a voyage into the dark depths of outrage, fury, and even madness.
But this is not uncharted territory, and we've been through tumultuous times as a nation before. We have stared into the abyss, and what has always brought us back is a recommitment to our shared values and institutions.
It has been heartening the past few days to see universal condemnation of political violence from all ends of the political spectrum. President Biden, President Trump, and leaders in Congress all spoke with one voice in condemning violence and calling for calm. Most impressively, I think, President Trump--with a bullet wound still fresh--called for unity and composure rather than rage and retribution.
Will this be just a temporary ceasefire on our smoldering political battlefield? When the smoke clears, will we revert to politics as bloodsport, figuratively and then literally?
We have an opportunity to step back from the brink--as Americans, not Republicans or Democrats. Yes, this election is important. There are very real policy differences between the candidates, and it's fair game to point out those differences in strong and clear terms.
But let's have a little perspective. This is not the end of times. The sun will come up on November 6th no matter who wins or loses, and the Republic will endure
Our political rhetoric should match that reality. This is a time for all of us to summon what Lincoln called the "better angels of our nature." Rather than revenge, let's seek reconciliation. Instead of dividing ourselves further, let's unite.
---
|
We can do better as a nation, but better is a choice. The choice is ours to make in the coming months, and I pray we choose wisely.
---

As always, never hesitate to reach out.
-- Paul Hudson

clean_body: An assassin’s bullet missed by an inch this weekend, but as a nation we inched toward the abyss. Where we go from here is a choice. | | | | == | Friend An assassin's bullet missed by an inch this weekend, but as a nation we inched toward the abyss. | Where we go from here is a choice. As a candidate for Congress, I think we have a responsibility to stop the dangerous rhetoric that has gotten us here. Politics are white hot right now, and the last thing we need is more gas on the fire. Our political culture is toxic. Political rhetoric is apocalyptic. We're told every election is the most important of our lifetime, a battle of good and evil with our very democracy and way of life on the line. When those are the supposed stakes, it's little surprise when violence ensues. | | As a candidate, I've seen the spiral of ugliness firsthand. Death threats. Casual calls to imprison and execute political opponents for treason. A quick trip to the comments section of any run-of-the-mill political post is a voyage into the dark depths of outrage, fury, and even madness. But this is not uncharted territory, and we've been through tumultuous times as a nation before. We have stared into the abyss, and what has always brought us back is a recommitment to our shared values and institutions. It has been heartening the past few days to see universal condemnation of political violence from all ends of the political spectrum. President Biden, President Trump, and leaders in Congress all spoke with one voice in condemning violence and calling for calm. Most impressively, I think, President Trump--with a bullet wound still fresh--called for unity and composure rather than rage and retribution. Will this be just a temporary ceasefire on our smoldering political battlefield? When the smoke clears, will we revert to politics as bloodsport, figuratively and then literally? We have an opportunity to step back from the brink--as Americans, not Republicans or Democrats. Yes, this election is important. There are very real policy differences between the candidates, and it's fair game to point out those differences in strong and clear terms. But let's have a little perspective. This is not the end of times. The sun will come up on November 6th no matter who wins or loses, and the Republic will endure Our political rhetoric should match that reality. This is a time for all of us to summon what Lincoln called the "better angels of our nature." Rather than revenge, let's seek reconciliation. Instead of dividing ourselves further, let's unite. | We can do better as a nation, but better is a choice. The choice is ours to make in the coming months, and I pray we choose wisely. body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1658%2E135344%2EpUXjiN)

[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-july24.5Fk0a0&refcode=em240717-1&t=2&akid=1658%2E135344%2EpUXjiN)
---
Friends --
While I know our campaign has sent a lot of emails before tonight's FEC deadline (yes, a very real one before Michigan's primary), I want to take a few minutes to tell you about my decision to run for Senate in the first place, and why your support is so important in our success.
The truth is, we all know America is _going through something_ right now. We seem to be living from crisis to crisis. But there are certain things that should be really simple:
Like living a middle-class life in the state that invented the middle class.
Like making things in America so that we’re in control of our own economic security.
Like protecting our children from the things that are _truly_ harming them.
And preserving our rights and our democracy so that our kids can live their version of the American dream.
**I’m running for Senate because I believe that we need a new generation of leaders that thinks differently, works harder, and never forgets the mission of public service.**
But my decision to run for Senate is also deeply personal to me, and it's related to what motivated me to first run for the House in 2018.
It's about my mom, Judy. She was diagnosed with stage IV ovarian cancer in 2009 — and didn't have health insurance at the time. She had let it lapse after the insurance companies had gouged her for years because she happened to have a pre-existing condition. She passed away in 2011, but that experience — of desperately trying to get her care at the same moment we were filling out bankruptcy paperwork — fueled me to run. I remember the exact moment that made me run: when the then-GOP controlled House of Representatives, the body I now serve in, voted to repeal those protections for people with pre-existing conditions.
Seven years later, the Republican leaders, fueled by the extreme wing of the party, are continuing the march to repeal things that the average Americans want. They want to privatize Social Security and Medicare, repeal drug price protections like allowing Medicare to negotiate, then there’s the rights they’re obsessed with repealing: a woman’s right to choose, voting rights, and any possible gun safety legislation.
By winning this Senate seat, we’ll help ensure that Democrats retain the (slight!) majority and can pass legislation that expands access to healthcare. Not the obsession with taking things away.
To be upfront: **Winning this race is going to take a lot of resources. A crazy amount. And we have to do it without raising a single dollar from corporate PACs.**
Donations this November – when we’re in the home stretch – are important. But donations now are even more important, because they allow us to map out a strategic plan and make decisions about when and how we reach voters.
[**That is why I would love it if you would consider donating $3 or whatever you can to my campaign before our FEC fundraising deadline ends tonight at midnight.](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-july24.5Fk0a0&refcode=em240717-1&t=3&akid=1658%2E135344%2EpUXjiN)**

Fellow American,

It's nearly election season. We hear promises from both sides of the aisle and commitments made to causes the American people rarely agree on.

Surprisingly, however, 7 in 10 Americans agree on this one thing:

**Across our nation, unborn babies should be protected by at least the point when they can feel pain. The latest science proves that unborn babies can feel pain by as early as 15 weeks.**

72% of voters agree on this issue but the American people are still being bombarded with lies and misinformation from Big Abortion and its allies. These "pro-choice" organizations are committed to using misleading information to manipulate women and destroy innocent children for their own gain in this billion-dollar industry.

In their own materials, Planned Parenthood states abortion is "one of the safest medical procedures performed in the United States" and "abortion has over a 99 percent safety record."

But how can this be true when a child's life is snatched from its mother's womb because it's purposefully put to death? Who is telling the American people the truth here?

_**What do you think about this?**_

[My team and I would love to know your opinion about abortion in America.](http://trk.libertyledger._UmwWUDRh9oH1K6-cnHg) We want to know your answers to questions like these:

Do you believe life begins at conception?

Do you believe abortion is harmful to women?

Do you believe that unborn babies have a right to life?

We want to hear what the American people think and invite you to take our [**Abortion in America Survey**](http://trk.libertyledger._dYIbgvIekl8mg) so we know where you stand.

Take the survey today and let us know if the majority of Americans are being lied to by a deadly industry. Help us find the truth by taking the survey today at the link below. We really want to get 10,000 responses from people just like you!

[https://action.sbaprolife.org/abortion-in-america](http://trk.libertyledger.)

For _LIFE,
_ Marjorie Dannenfelser
President, SBA Pro-Life America

I graduated from the United States Naval Academy and served for 25 years in Navy Special Operations in Iraq, Afghanistan, and Somalia. As inflation steadily rises, it erodes the purchasing power of your hard-earned money, making it imperative to safeguard your wealth during these uncertain times.
Precious metals like gold and silver have consistently proven to be reliable safe-haven assets.
They retain value and often appreciate during economic instability, making them essential components of a diversified investment portfolio.
Allocating a portion of your assets to precious metals protects against the devaluation of currency and ensures long-term financial security.

| | Friend, God had his hand upon America over the weekend. Let’s not slap it away. **I’m Tim Sheehy. Those are also my pronouns. SHEE – He**.

I’m a former Navy SEAL. My wife is a Marine. I led Americans in the battle to defend our country. Then, we came home to live the American Dream in Montana.

We started an aerial firefighting business in our barn. We created hundreds of jobs and protected our public lands and Montanans from devastating wildfires.

Jon Tester is the deciding vote for Biden’s America Last agenda. He got an F from the NRA. He voted to put a liberal judge on the Supreme Court who couldn’t define what a woman is. He even drives a Prius in D.C.

name: Ro Khanna
subject: The Supreme Court obliterated 40 years of precedent. This is how Congress can make it right.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ro for Congress
body:
https://rokhanna.com [https://rokhanna.com]

Friend,

Last month, the Supreme Court overturned Chevron deference, the foundation of modern administrative law. It guides courts to defer to the expertise of federal agencies when dealing with ambiguities in the specifics of regulations. For example, judges, not experts, may now be forced to handle technical questions [https://www.nrdc.org/stories/what-happens-if-supreme-court-ends-chevron-deference] about equipment use or complex questions [https://www.nrdc.org/stories/what-happens-if-supreme-court-ends-chevron-deference] about how weather patterns impact downwind air pollution.

In throwing it out, they obliterated 40 years of precedent and upended our entire system of reasonable regulatory checks on corporate power.

60% of regulations [https://www.arnoldporter.com/en/perspectives/advisories/2024/07/when-apa-claims-accrue-under-corner-post] – including those protecting the environment, worker’s rights, and public health – rely on Chevron deference. Each and every one, no matter how long-standing, could now be under attack.

Tell Congress: Protect common-sense regulations. [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/chevron-doctrine-petition?contactdata=Zd43ztfwE70x3gnTS7yfDVFrISe0TCRkIxChx0OOlZcNJnZuS/l4k99gxC03ZHEwjmjhHRUWTe1/Wnyy4ZrR5Suufr7xrK1YvDex98DA57Tm2Dca7oL9yZeWEauY9BVvNbvLaHA7AS0HEZ08nJ4Tqg==]

https://twitter.com/RoKhanna/status/1806732783009571143 [https://twitter.com/RoKhanna/status/1806732783009571143]

The far-right Supreme Court is sabotaging the public interest. As Justice Kagan remarked [https://www.supremecourt.gov/opinions/23pdf/22-451_7m58.pdf] , “the majority turns itself into the country’s administrative czar," giving unaccountable judges an effective veto [https://slate.com/news-and-politics/2024/06/elena-kagan-dissent-supreme-court-john-roberts-chevron-disaster.html] over experts.

TAKE ACTION: Tell Congress to codify the Chevron doctrine and protect public interest over unchecked greed. [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/chevron-doctrine-petition?contactdata=Zd43ztfwE70x3gnTS7yfDVFrISe0TCRkIxChx0OOlZcNJnZuS/l4k99gxC03ZHEwjmjhHRUWTe1/Wnyy4ZrR5Suufr7xrK1YvDex98DA57Tm2Dca7oL9yZeWEauY9BVvNbvLaHA7AS0HEZ08nJ4Tqg==]

Thank you for your activism and all that you do.

In solidarity,
Ro

Greetings, Today, I am reaching out with an urgent and heartfelt plea for your support in our fight to dismantle systemic injustices and protect the democratic rights of all Americans. Following the recent attempted assassination of former President Donald J. Trump, our campaign for Dr. Cornel West, an independent candidate for President of the United States, has formally requested Secret Service protection. This request underscores the critical need for equitable safety measures for all presidential candidates, regardless of their political views or the nature of their criticisms.

body:

Currently, the **Republican National Convention** is taking place and there is a slew of speakers from Politicians to every day Americans in the lineup. One of the speakers on the opening night was [Amber Rose](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=13475643.6964.1.362d6b4667c9d8c9fae8224ba7a83e80). [Amber Rose](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=13475643.6965.1.94beb972063358044b385889a8640d7a) is a social media influencer with millions of followers. She is not a Christian (_YET_) but she has just had a conversion from _hard-core liberal_ to **MAGA supporter**. After she spoke, **X** (aka Twitter) exploded with Christian Conservatives losing their minds that someone like [Amber Rose](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=13475643.6966.1.a7163aa604dc7becfdf61cc8ca5f07c9) was allowed to speak. In response, I tweeted that I was glad [Amber Rose](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=13475643.6967.1.1b1bd6b85a0e7d03b9b3f7f98a335060) spoke at the RNC. This tweet has led to Christians accusing me of not being a Christian. The RNC Convention is a Political Convention _NOT_ a Church Service. The Republican Party needs more influencers like [Amber Rose](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=13475643.6968.1.21ce023a9c39a6b06d3da8bbde21c3f8) to reach a generation that the Democrats nearly totally control. Do I agree with the lifestyle of [Amber Rose](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=13475643.6969.1.5a0d049cdbaee89e7865fa6f66037e97)? No. But.. I do agree with her that for the betterment of all Americans, we need to elect Donald Trump. One of the ways we elect Donald Trump is by reaching voters who may not be Christian but are concerned Americans. Therefore, I suggest to some of these Christians losing their minds over [Amber Rose](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=13475643.6970.1.faccdfc142070fa7297e7430282bcc09) to calm down. **I might be a Pastor but I am not a Pharisee.** I am praying that just as [Amber Rose](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=13475643.6971.1.d6ed31fe6b04346e47d728d712b058f1) had an awakening to the truth about Donald Trump that she will also have an awakening to the TRUTH about Jesus Christ. Thank you,

disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
We always knew that this would be one of the closest races in the country. That’s no secret. But we’ve been really fortunate so far because month after month we have absolutely crushed Kari Lake’s fundraising numbers. That gives us a tremendous advantage, and it lets us deliver our message to the people who need to hear it.
#

Peter, Kari Lake directly addressed the Republican National Convention last night.
She had a prime-time slot, one of the biggest of the night. I’m not going to speculate on how many people watched, but I can tell you one thing for sure: It was the biggest platform she’s ever had.
We always knew that this would be one of the closest races in the country. That’s no secret. But we’ve been really fortunate so far because month after month we have absolutely crushed Kari Lake’s fundraising numbers. That gives us a tremendous advantage, and it lets us deliver our message to the people who need to hear it.
All that could change in an instant, though. The kind of national attention that Kari Lake got last night could turn into millions of dollars raised in the blink of an eye. Big donors send in massive checks, the millions of MAGA faithful add their donations, and before you know it we’re the ones getting crushed. It’s Kari Lake’s ads flooding the airwaves and our chances at defending Arizona and holding the U.S. Senate collapse.
The only way we’ll prevent that from happening is if we continue to raise the resources we need to win.
I need you with me. It’s as simple as that.
[**Can I count on you to use this link and make a contribution to my campaign for U.S. Senate? name: Sam Holman, Evergreen
subject: 🎥 New film: Alijah
body:
"It's not about the money but to get paid for something that you really love doing—man, I'm blessed."
| | | | [](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2699759/87SdQ4wZ) |
---|---|---
---
| Hi there,

Clean energy = better communities. And if you're looking for something to ground your hope for the future during a period full of frightening headlines, we have the answer.

I just went to Detroit to see what the clean energy economy looked like on the ground—and I brought a camera with me. |
---
[WATCH NOW](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2699760/87SdQ4wZ)
---
---
| **The folks I met in Detroit were clear: America's clean energy boom is delivering the most equitable economy in America’s history.**

For the first time, money is flowing into Black, Brown, and low-income communities—**delivering jobs, lowering energy costs, and reducing pollution.**

I saw what that means for myself when I met Walker-Miller Founder and CEO Carla Walker-Miller and a graduate of her workforce development program, Alijah Thomas. |
[](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2699761/87SdQ4wZ)
---
---
| "The fact that this administration is now aggressively addressing climate change... is one of the most hopeful and uplifting things that is happening right now in this country. And I and so many others are running to thoughtfully and carefully and responsibly spend this money for the good of all Americans."— Carla Walker-Miller |
---
| Thanks to the program, which is being expanded by investments in the Inflation Reduction Act and Michigan's own clean energy package, Alijah is making a difference in his community while making the most money he's ever made. And thanks to the same policies, Alijah's neighbors can afford to make home investments that lower their bills, improve the comfort of their home, and help them breathe cleaner air.

[**Watch and share our short film about Alijah to help spread the word:**](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2699762/87SdQ4wZ)**Clean energy investments are making a real difference in our communities.** |
---
[ALIJAH'S STORY](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2699763/87SdQ4wZ)
---
---
| Thank you for watching, |
---
| | |
---
### Sam Holman
Digital Director
Evergreen Collaborative

body:
Here’s a quick run-down of what the new V.P. nominee stands for.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2270%2E4032634%2E2_9kLd)
---
In case you’ve recently asked yourself, “Who’s J.D. Vance again?”, here’s a quick run-down of what he stands for: He called Social Security and Medicare “the biggest roadblocks to any kind of real fiscal sanity.” Combine that with the fact that Trump proposed cutting Social Security and Medicare in every single one of his budgets, and it’s clear that with Trump-Vance, **Social Security and Medicare cuts** will bear down on seniors like an avalanche. Vance thinks seniors should get by with less while billionaires get more tax breaks. Trump’s only major legislative achievement was a $2 trillion tax cut mostly soaked up by millionaires, billionaires, and giant corporations. Now Vance is backing Trump as he proposes **another billionaire tax break** that is worth $3.5 million apiece, every year — $3.5 million a year for every billionaire. So, Wall Street and Silicon Valley billionaires are cheering him on. You know who else is in his corner? Anti-abortion rights extremists. He’s supported **abortion bans without exceptions for rape or incest because “two wrongs don’t make a right.” He said he “certainly would like abortion to be illegal nationally.” And he voted against protections for IVF.** Now, you might be thinking that he sounds about as extreme as Trump’s last vice president, Mike Pence. And you might be wondering why Trump, Vance, and their party think they can win elections on such a toxic, unpopular agenda. That brings us to January 6. Vance said he **wouldn’t have certified the 2020 election results the way Pence did.** Instead, he would have entertained lies about voter fraud and encouraged slates of fake electors. He claimed that only a “few bad apples” were responsible for the insurrection. He called the January 6 commission a “sham.” And the more he and Trump undermine our democracy to deny the will of the people, the less they have to worry about whether their plans are popular. **Now that you’ve read all those paragraphs, your blood pressure may be spiking.** **So let’s take a moment to picture the positive future we’re pushing for, not just the horrors we’re working to prevent.** If we re-elect President Joe Biden and Vice President Kamala Harris with a Democratic Congress, we can pass a national law ensuring the right to an abortion. We can shore up our democracy, including with legislation defending the freedom to vote. We can tax the rich and lower costs for working families — on child care, on housing, with junk fees, and more. We can get it all done and more — if we fight side by side. One step at a time. One foot in front of the other. **But a big piece of this puzzle is holding onto our Democratic majority in the U.S. Senate. I’m up for re-election this fall, and a right-wing Super PAC has already started up against me — creating a vehicle for national Republicans, special interests, Big Tech moguls, Wall Street executives, and far-right ideologues to pour large sums of money into our race.** Defeating us in Massachusetts would virtually guarantee a GOP-controlled Senate. And national Republicans are desperate to take power so they can enact their radical agenda. [**I’m asking if you can make a donation of $28 or any amount to support our re-election campaign right now — because we can’t underestimate how much money national Republicans and outside special interests can spend trying to defeat us, and we have to stop their radical agenda so we can put Washington on the side of working people.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2421?amount=28&t=8&akid=2270%2E4032634%2E2_9kLd)

subject: For the first time in a decade

body:
This is our chance to double down on our support for fair maps
|
---
Peter,
My home state of Wisconsin has been in the news A LOT this week. Let’s quickly remind ourselves just how central Wisconsin has been in our work in recent years:
**FIRST:** Extreme lawmakers in Wisconsin egregiously gerrymandered the legislative maps to drown out the will of the people – which gave then-Governor Scott Walker a free ticket to wreak havoc on our state.
**THEN:** We fought back at the grassroots level. It took _years_ for us to build our power, make the case for fair maps, and ultimately win a set of maps that is far more representative. The new legislative maps Wisconsin will use in November are in no small part the culmination of years and years of organizing.

subject: How to solve 2 Big Problems
body:
Homeland Security. Problem #1. We’ve got to close our southern border and fund our police.Rising food costs. Problem #2. How can we afford to feed | | | [View this email in your browser](https://us2.campaign-archive.com/?e=5a45ee1154&u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=dfc3e7ea4a)
---
| |
---
| Peter,

Let's work together to solve problems.

Homeland Security. Problem #1. We’ve got to close our southern border and fund our police.

Rising food costs. Problem #2. How can we afford to feed our families when even the cost of eggs has gone up by 116% since 2021?
[](https://mdpetitions.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=2ac60b104d&e=5a45ee1154)
You will be very excited to hear about our guest on Thursday, July 25th.

Congressman Andy Harris will be speaking about his experience not only as Maryland’s only Republican Congressman (so far!) but also as Chairman of the Appropriations Subcommittee on Agriculture, Rural Development, Food & Drug Administration.

Congressman Harris is also a member of two additional appropriation subcommittees: Labor, Health and Human Services, Education and ... Homeland Security.

If you care about Problem #1 and Problem #2, you are going to want to hear what Congressman Harris, someone who works on these very issues in our nation’s capital, has to say.
---

---
| | **Congressman Harris flipped his current Congressional seat from Democrat to Republican,** so he knows what it takes. Congressman Harris is supporting Neil, and he believes that Neil can win this open Congressional seat in the 6th Congressional District.

We’ve got the momentum. With your help, Neil outraised his opponent this last quarter. Thank you! But we cannot sit back on this one. Any support you can give allows us to put ads up, to contact voters, and perhaps most importantly, to encourage “low propensity Republican voters” to request a mail-in ballot. We’ve got a voter-outreach plan - we just need to fund it!

If you can come out to meet Andy Harris, we’d love to see you. If you are able to contribute towards the voter outreach plan, we’d love your help. Let’s keep the momentum going. Our country is worth the work!

To RSVP to meet us in Walkersville with Congressman Harris, click this link: [https://secure.winred.com/neilparrott/andyharrisatking](https://mdpetitions.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=52b8670063&e=5a45ee1154)

name: Maurice Mitchell, Working Families Party
subject: Our path in a moment of political uncertainty
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Working Families Party PAC (77 Sands St
body:
Are you ready to join us to learn more about how you can help us assemble the united front we’ll need to stand up to authoritarianism? | | | Peter, Saturday’s shooting at a rally for former President Donald Trump shocked the nation. It left many of us feeling scared and uncertain. Despite the history of political violence in the MAGA movement, some cynical political operatives and pundits are signaling that Saturday’s shooting should make Trump politically untouchable. Senior Democrats are reportedly resigning themselves to a Trump presidency. But the last thing we can afford to do is give in to despair or throw in the towel. **We’re hosting the third in our series of mass calls along with Movement for Black Lives, Seed the Vote, and SURJ to make meaning of this moment on Thursday, July 18 at 8 PM ET/5 PM PT.** On the call, we’ll grapple with the current political moment and lay out our strategy for how we can win for working families. [**Will we see you there? RSVP here, and we’ll send you the link to join Thursday’s call.**](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMbGj-ca0TYSsYMZBvIweYdJxZAP5xLg1YZaKIinIFmIxwneR9YUH85oX6XyKoEwATL_hbR3LKU0fNB3u-IwAuIycRN266fgHBUdtvOo-3w0JH-9lMX52XorEwec2ujzT2NyMnNbqYnXUvUo5aizebnzmFSelL4vDERLPD7rCfa268ncrwdudfnv1TlFv31aUBswHnbfzJCRG59_UHNB69tzmJbZ-MERSH1d6MLmpTftLK8KP2nb2fjM-ZYDgMPJbHCfTCubpqrsuEJccsk6L2Qf5t2GN5_XV9HtdyILmNEkd/484/GsM0Mv9tRE2-nerLzhq5IA/h0/h001.YZ5RlP5PGqbIfiopN0mjskwr1yqB-TYomOSTerRfCSI) **[RSVP now](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMbGj-ca0TYSsYMZBvIweYdJxZAP5xLg1YZaKIinIFmIxwneR9YUH85oX6XyKoEwATL_hbR3LKU0fNB3u-IwAuIycRN266fgHBUdtvOo-3w0JLl9Za0ZyGl9xM8vWyuv-wk7cfH2rBZN4nPFmPqbHqMn-KNED9dOO2osVDT0Eor-IFuWU5hsVThxlniRK75olRImcZc0zoToS_aKIsxyRXGASZO9IqtmSO3Z9lsnYC_ypRuLw9vPwqqOOBnun3VkjMcpDs48XcUPJB9wwqwOZ1jqh68pXx_RO58A5nQLX58XA/484/GsM0Mv9tRE2-nerLzhq5IA/h1/h001.TGqCQ-ILoE0kpmbpv6nMh63_FPr7-x7cU_DvdAEodc8)** The violence we witnessed on Saturday didn’t happen in a vacuum. Since day one, Trump has used his platform to fan the flames of violence and hate. He has called for civil rights protesters to be shot, encouraged police to brutalize innocent people, told the far-right extremist group the Proud Boys to “stand by” during a 2020 presidential debate, and incited an attack on the Capitol on January 6th, 2021. During the Trump years, right-wing extremists attacked the Tree of Life synagogue in Pittsburgh, injured former Speaker Nancy Pelosi’s husband in a home invasion, and massacred ten Black people in a Buffalo grocery store. Trump has also made it clear that he will only be more emboldened in a second term. His friends in the MAGA movement have already drafted a 900-page plan called “Project 2025” detailing exactly what they want to do if they win. They want to bring all government agencies under the direct control of the President, slash taxes for big corporations while gutting our healthcare, tear apart families and cage immigrants in massive detention camps, and ban abortion nationwide. They also want to break the back of the labor movement. Like any bad boss, Trump sees organized workers as a threat to his power. We can defeat Donald Trump and his MAGA movement. clean_body: Are you ready to join us to learn more about how you can help us assemble the united front we’ll need to stand up to authoritarianism? | | | Peter, Saturday’s shooting at a rally for former President Donald Trump shocked the nation. It left many of us feeling scared and uncertain. Despite the history of political violence in the MAGA movement, some cynical political operatives and pundits are signaling that Saturday’s shooting should make Trump politically untouchable. Senior Democrats are reportedly resigning themselves to a Trump presidency. But the last thing we can afford to do is give in to despair or throw in the towel. We’re hosting the third in our series of mass calls along with Movement for Black Lives, Seed the Vote, and SURJ to make meaning of this moment on Thursday, July 18 at 8 PM ET/5 PM PT. On the call, we’ll grapple with the current political moment and lay out our strategy for how we can win for working families. The violence we witnessed on Saturday didn’t happen in a vacuum. Since day one, Trump has used his platform to fan the flames of violence and hate. He has called for civil rights protesters to be shot, encouraged police to brutalize innocent people, told the far-right extremist group the Proud Boys to “stand by” during a 2020 presidential debate, and incited an attack on the Capitol on January 6th, 2021. During the Trump years, right-wing extremists attacked the Tree of Life synagogue in Pittsburgh, injured former Speaker Nancy Pelosi’s husband in a home invasion, and massacred ten Black people in a Buffalo grocery store. Trump has also made it clear that he will only be more emboldened in a second term. His friends in the MAGA movement have already drafted a 900-page plan called “Project 2025” detailing exactly what they want to do if they win. They want to bring all government agencies under the direct control of the President, slash taxes for big corporations while gutting our healthcare, tear apart families and cage immigrants in massive detention camps, and ban abortion nationwide. They also want to break the back of the labor movement. Like any bad boss, Trump sees organized workers as a threat to his power. We can defeat Donald Trump and his MAGA movement. It will take us uniting a broad coalition of people across race, age, and identity. This united front was critical to defeating Trump in 2020. It’s now on us to do it again in 2024. Our movement needs to lay out a clear and compelling vision for how we can build a country where everyone can live in safety, peace, and freedom. That thread connects all of our work, from organizing for a ceasefire in Gaza to making sure every person in our country has quality health care. None of us should have to live in a state of fear and anxiety. We can choose to live in a country where we feel safe visiting a grocery store or place of worship, where we don’t have to worry about weapons of war being used against school children or political figures, and where we can care for our health and the health of our loved ones without taking on crushing debt. The far right can be beaten. We’ve done it before. But there are no guarantees. The only thing that can get us there is organizing. Resigning ourselves to authoritarianism isn’t an option. Can you believe it,
Peter?

Today marks 20 days until the Michigan Senate primary! That’s 20 days left
until everything Hill has been advocating for — universal healthcare,
environmental justice, cleaning up government corruption — goes head to
head with the establishment at the ballot box.

This is big stuff we’re talking about! Let’s take a quick trip down memory lane

Now that the general election this November is on the horizon, our campaign is ramping things up. After all, we have an extremist incumbent to defeat. Luckily, we have organized an amazing volunteer team, who are out knocking on doors, registering voters, and hosting events... But all of that takes time and resources.

body:
If you saw our email from Saturday morning, you’ll know that our grassroots fundraising has slowed down quite a bit so far in July.
#
Hi,
Ian here. As Finance Director, I wanted to give you a quick update on our July fundraising — as well as ask you to [**pitch in to help us raise the $4,303 we need to make up ASAP.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240717-1?amount=5&refcode=em20240717-1-823&refcode2=823_21716_lz_wwj&akid=823%2E21716%2Elz_wwj)
**If you saw our email from Saturday morning, you’ll know that our grassroots fundraising has slowed down quite a bit so far in July. Here’s a chart in case you missed it:**

[**Sarah’s primary election is less than two months away, so we really need to ramp up our fundraising to get her positive message out to voters. clean_body: We set a goal yesterday and fell well short of where we needed to end up. If there is anything you can do, please help me right now. | Fellow American, I’m Tim Sheehy. Those are also my pronouns. SHEE – He. That’s a joke, but it shows the lunacy we’re living with in Joe Biden and Jon Tester’s America. I’m a former Navy SEAL. My wife is a Marine. I led Americans in the battle to defend our country. Then, we came home to live the American Dream in Montana. We started an aerial firefighting business in our barn. We created hundreds of jobs and protected our public lands and Montanans from devastating wildfires. I fight fires, so take it from me: the world is on fire under Joe Biden. Consider Biden’s disgraceful retreat from Afghanistan. He let our enemies steal our equipment—and kill 13 heroic American servicemembers. Jon Tester is the deciding vote for Biden’s America Last agenda. He got an F from the NRA. He voted to put a liberal judge on the Supreme Court who couldn’t define what a woman is. He even drives a Prius in D.C. Jon Tester doesn’t represent Montanans. He’s a rubber stamp for Biden’s failed presidency. It’s time to retire them both. Listen, I’m an optimist. If you're not, you can’t jump out of planes at night into enemy territory. I believe America’s future will be better than our past. However, we need political outsiders like President Trump to bring back common sense. What Montanans think is common sense is pretty simple: They want a secure border, safe streets, and cheap gas. They think cops are good, criminals are bad, boys are boys, and girls are girls. I’m ready to retire Jon Tester and take back the U.S. Senate! Will you help me finish the job by donating I’m ready to join you in sending President Donald J. Trump back to the White House! We have to save America! For America's Future, Tim Sheehy Former Navy SEAL Republican for U.S. Senate | " "I SERVED AS A NAVY SEAL, BUILT ONE OF THE LARGEST AERIAL FIREFIGHTING COMPANIES IN AMERICA CREATING OVER 200 MONTANA JOBS, AND STARTED A VETERAN-LED CATTLE RANCHING AND FEEDING OPERATION. WHETHER IT WAS IN WAR OR BUSINESS, I SEE PROBLEMS AND SOLVE THEM. AMERICA NEEDS CONSERVATIVE LEADERS WHO LOVE OUR COUNTRY. I'M RUNNING FOR THE U.S. SENATE BECAUSE OUR CAMPAIGN IS ABOUT SERVICE, DUTY, AND COUNTRY -- NOT POLITICS AS USUAL." | PAID FOR BY TIM SHEEHY FOR MONTANA Tim Sheehy is a former Navy SEAL.
