name: Jill Stein
subject: For Eric
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jill Stein for President 2024
body:
| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=eric_garner&n=1)
---
_Note: Today’s message contains descriptions of police brutality related to the murder of Eric Garner. If you prefer to skip this message, please consider supporting his family’s ongoing advocacy with a contribution to the_**[ _E.R.I.C. Initiative Foundation_](https://www.jillstein2024.com/r?u=zgMp9ac2rHeUkGZ2Xp2rAMhgNVvMSS0nysbjjoJNYhgkfLq-AK6fdTrhC944__A6Y7ePbKQtUpwCQYivvW6ooQ&e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=eric_garner&n=2)** _today._
---
* * *
---
Peter,

Ten years ago today, Eric Garner was murdered by the NYPD.

Even for those of us steeped in activism and advocacy work, there are unforgettable, watershed moments.

This was one of them.
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/r?u=zgMp9ac2rHeUkGZ2Xp2rAMhgNVvMSS0nysbjjoJNYhgkfLq-AK6fdTrhC944__A6Y7ePbKQtUpwCQYivvW6ooQ&e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=eric_garner&n=3)
---
The horrible irony is that Eric wasn’t even the target that day. A fight had broken out in the neighborhood, and someone called the police for help.

Eric, the 6’3” father of six, known to the neighborhood as a ‘gentle giant’, helped break up that fight and calm everyone down.

NYPD arrived on the scene after the commotion was over, and instead of moving along they began to harass the good samaritan who stepped in to help.

Eric was accused of selling untaxed cigarettes. They argued with him. As he became frustrated, they tackled him to the ground without cause.

**The officers pinned him down using an illegal chokehold maneuver, and Eric repeatedly cried out**** _“I can’t breathe!” until he died.

_** In the weeks that followed, those words became a rallying cry – one that would resurface six years later in the murder of George Floyd.

**Ten years after Eric’s murder, we are no closer to the radical reordering of prisons and policing that his death demanded.

** Despite millions of people marching and demanding change, both Democrats and Republicans continue dumping billions of dollars into militarizing the police.

Instead of answering the demands of citizens who speak out against state sanctioned violence, **they are building Cop Cities all across America** to train cops as dystopian super soldiers suppressing free speech and the right to protest – training organized and provided by Israeli soldiers, in many cases.

**That changes with**** _us_****.

** Our campaign worked with activists, advocates, experts, and community leaders to put forth a transformative agenda on [**prisons and policing**](https://www.jillstein2024.com/platform?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=eric_garner&n=4).

When elected, I will push Congress to pass the _George Floyd Justice in Policing Act_. But that is just the beginning.

I will end qualified immunity – a practice first established to protect members of the KKK — that currently acts as a shield for police brutality and prosecutorial misconduct.

I will bring ALL police misconduct allegations under federal authority so cops with repeated allegations of abuse and violence can’t shop for a new city to brutalize when they’ve worn out their welcome in another.

**We will do all of this and a whole lot more, and we will have justice for Eric – whose legacy still lives on through his family’s advocacy.

** A few months ago, Eric’s mother Gwen opened the first office location of the E.R.I.C. Initiative Foundation on Staten Island.
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/r?u=zgMp9ac2rHeUkGZ2Xp2rAMhgNVvMSS0nysbjjoJNYhgkfLq-AK6fdTrhC944__A6Y7ePbKQtUpwCQYivvW6ooQ&e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=eric_garner&n=5)
---
The E.R.I.C. Initiative Foundation works with families who have been victims of police brutality and seeks to address the underlying issues of systemic racism and reforming our systems of prison and policing.

**As we mark 10 years since Eric’s death, I ask that you join me today in making a contribution to support his family’s work.**
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/r?u=zgMp9ac2rHeUkGZ2Xp2rAMhgNVvMSS0nysbjjoJNYhgkfLq-AK6fdTrhC944__A6Y7ePbKQtUpwCQYivvW6ooQ&e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=eric_garner&n=6 "Donate to E.R.I.C.") [Donate to E.R.I.C.](https://www.jillstein2024.com/r?u=zgMp9ac2rHeUkGZ2Xp2rAMhgNVvMSS0nysbjjoJNYhgkfLq-AK6fdTrhC944__A6Y7ePbKQtUpwCQYivvW6ooQ&e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=eric_garner&n=6)
---
**And if you’re able to give twice today, help me build a brand new legal system that’s actually centered on JUSTICE by[delivering our mandate for change at the ballot box this November](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=eric_garner&n=7).

**Eric’s murder was a senseless act of casual police brutality that we vehemently condemn – and we will never accept this as normal.

You can learn more about our plans to transform prisons and policing in America on our platform **[here](https://www.jillstein2024.com/platform?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=eric_garner&n=8)**. Please share freely to help us spread the word!

In solidarity and gratitude,

Jill
---

body:
Peninsula Humane Society & SPCA on July 23rd! RSVP today! | | | |
---
| | |
# July 23rd in San Mateo
---
|
---
| [](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=3f04b0d9df&e=c0babbc643)

Please[ ](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=5ae2b16411&e=c0babbc643)[join us](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=9df7fbe410&e=c0babbc643) to learn how pets play a role in improving physical and mental well-being for kids, families and older adults at a special event my office is holding in partnership with the Peninsula Humane Society 4 p.m. to 6 p.m., Tuesday, July 23, 12 Airport Blvd., San Mateo. According to famed UK veterinarian _Dr. Marc Abraham OBE: “The_ _ _ inability to leave the house is a common symptom of loneliness, so having to walk a dog once or twice daily encourages outside physical fitness, lowers rates of obesity and increases the frequency and likelihood of real life human-human interactions.” At our [PHS event](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=3dd9b1a3bb&e=c0babbc643), you will learn how you can adopt your forever furry friend including dogs, cats, small animals and even exotic animals such as lizards, snakes and turtles [https://phs-spca.org/adopt/exotic-animals/](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=4ed6017580&e=c0babbc643). This event launches the first of many in my office’s “Loneliness t o Light Series.” Abraham continues on the Campaign to End Loneliness blog: “Indeed, having a dog by your side is often the ultimate conversation starter, igniting connections, thus reducing feelings of social isolation. Staying home with a cat, rabbit, or any other furry or feathered friend also offers a degree of companionship and interaction, including fulfilling daily routines, which can all help support and manage long-term mental health issues such as depression, anxiety and loneliness.” [https://www.campaigntoendloneliness.org/the-importance-of-animals-tackling-loneliness-one-pet-at-a-time/](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=c05fbdb41f&e=c0babbc643) [_**RSVP HERE!**_](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=cf25146c03&e=c0babbc643)

As a filmmaker, I've always been deeply interested in the moments that defined the American spirit — the Civil War, the Great Depression, the Second World War, the Vietnam War, the Civil Rights Movement.

Hello, Peter. This is Ken Burns.
As a filmmaker, I've always been deeply interested in the moments that defined the American spirit — the Civil War, the Great Depression, the Second World War, the Vietnam War, the Civil Rights Movement.
These were inflection points where we were forced to live up to the essential promise of our nation: preserving a democratic system of government that respects the rights and addresses the needs of all its citizens.
As Benjamin Franklin so wisely put it, "A Republic, if you can keep it."
Today, we face a new generational challenge. Our system of government is in great peril. The democratic values that make up the very fabric of our nation are under assault and at risk of unraveling. It has never been more important that we come together to ensure that our republic endures for future generations.
To meet that challenge, we need leaders who understand how important our democracy is and what it truly means to serve. That's why I’m writing to you on behalf of Ruben Gallego. Ruben is the son of immigrant parents, the first in his family to go to college, a Marine veteran, and a father.
His opponent, Kari Lake, attacks our elections at every turn. She sows the very same discord that is tearing our country apart. She is dangerous. Where Ruben would unite us, Kari Lake seeks only division.
We need more people like Ruben serving our country, and it would mean the world to me if you could support his campaign.
[**Can you make a donation of $25 or whatever you can afford to Ruben’s campaign for U.S. Senate in Arizona? We started an aerial firefighting business in our barn. We created hundreds of jobs and protected our public lands and Montanans from devastating wildfires.

I fight fires, so take it from me: the world is on fire under Joe Biden.

Jon Tester is the deciding vote for Biden’s America Last agenda. He got an F from the NRA. He voted to put a liberal judge on the Supreme Court who couldn’t define what a woman is. He even drives a Prius in D.C.

* He gave J.D. Vance, Donald Trump's pick for vice president, his _full support_.

* He threw his support behind their extremist, out-of-touch, self-serving agenda to roll back reproductive rights and cut vital programs like Social Security and Medicare.

* And he announced a new $400,000 ad buy to run even more ads against Debbie.

body:
| Folks —

Today, we close the books on the last official FEC fundraising deadline before we know who our opponent will be in the November election.

This isn't one of those quarterly FEC deadlines we email about, but it is an official deadline — and probably the most important of the campaign.

Here's why:

After July 17th, we're legally required to report what we've raised and how much money we have in the bank since our last deadline on June 30th. Same for our eventual opponent.

Our report will give super PACs a glimpse at the financial strength of our campaign just before we formally enter the general election, and they will use that information when deciding whether or not to run attack ads against us, or if they should move on to another race.

We want to file as strong a report as we possibly can, but with only 17 days between deadlines, that’s going to require a lot of support from a whole bunch of people giving whatever they can.

I wish we didn't have to make these requests this often via email, but the truth is it is where a majority of the donations we receive come from. So, I am asking:

body:
Because Wisconsin is a swing state, the GOP knows how vital our 10 electoral votes are to winning the White House.

| Republican extremists from all over the U.S. have descended upon Milwaukee for their convention to spread their lies and attack all the progress we’ve made.

The GOP is counting on the Republican National Convention to launch them to victory in Wisconsin, a state they barely lost in 2020.

So, true to form, I stood up, spoke out, and spoke truth to power. While my opponents were lavished with long bios and praise in the poll, I was reduced to a mere descriptor: "a Black legislator." I’m not even a legislator, although I am an elected official – an executive! My lifelong commitment to public service, my science degrees, my advocacy for marginalized communities, and my expertise in education and health policy were brushed aside with a single dismissive sentence as if my lived experience and career accomplishments counted for nothing. This was not just an attack on me; it's an assault on every Black voice that does the work to achieve justice and equality. It's a stark reminder of the deep-seated biases and inequalities that still pervade our political system. The powers that be are threatened because they see us - yes, you and me, Peter - rising up like a phoenix. But I refuse to be silenced or sidelined. I refuse to let their falsehoods define me or my campaign. Now, more than ever, I need your support to fight back against these underhanded, divisive tactics. Will you make a donation of stand with me today? Your contribution will fuel our movement to counter the falsehoods, amplify our message of progress, and reach every corner of our toss-up, open-seat district with the truth. Together, we will build a coalition that stands against injustice and fights for integrity and fairness in our democracy. If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly: = = = = Contrary to what some may believe, I have not been seeking the support of establishment donors or the backing of the DCCC. Though it could have been the case, in the words of my former opponent Mayor Sheldon Neeley of Flint, before he dropped out of the race, “[black candidates] can push the bus, but not ride the bus”. As with many Black candidates, I have served the Democratic party for decades, but now feel as if our campaign has been written off and never given a chance by the national party. Meanwhile, my opponent Kristen McDonald Rivet – a first-term State Senator who I just helped get elected to serve in that role – is now attempting to be springboarded into this office which covers a more urban population. But, I don't need their help because I have you, Peter. I am committed to running a grassroots campaign because my allegiance lies with my neighbors, my coworkers, my fellow Michigan working families, and you – my grassroots supporters who are pitching in $1, $8, and $20.24 at a time. The people are who I am beholden to and who I will serve in office, who I will listen to, and who I will fight for – not special interests or the Democratic Party leaders in Washington D.C. This campaign is more than just an election—it's a call to action. It's a summons to forge a future where every voice matters, and every person is valued. = Together, we can make history. Together, we can make a real difference. Yours in solidarity, – Dr. Pamela Pugh ****************** | I’m Dr. Pamela Pugh, and I’m a Saginaw native running for Congress in Michigan's 8th District. As a public servant, I currently serve as the President of the Michigan State Board of Education, a statewide elected position. I believe in standing up for the people and fighting for our democracy, our children, and our future. I've lived in Michigan's 8th District for my entire life and it will be the honor of a lifetime to represent my community in the House of Representatives. Derek,
**In 2006, Montana elected Democrat Jon Tester to the Senate,** unseating a three-term Republican incumbent. Since then, he’s been reelected twice.
Jon is a different kind of politician. He’s a farmer, who got into politics because he was sick of corruption and cronyism. In the Senate, he passed comprehensive ethics reform, got rid of the revolving door between lobbyists and his office, and is working to get big money out of politics altogether.
That’s exactly why corporate executives don’t like Jon. And it’s why they’re spending millions to unseat him this election cycle. **[Will you help Jon fight back by splitting a donation between his campaign and Truth to Power today?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20240717-tester?refcode=em20240717-38988&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=38988_3422442_n4bjcK&akid=38988%2E3422442%2En4bjcK)**

Montanans trust Jon for many of the same reasons that Katie’s constituents trust her. Like Katie, he is deeply committed to transparency. In fact, Jon was the first federal lawmaker to publish his daily schedule online, something he has done every day for almost two decades.
It is this commitment that has earned him the support of Montanans three terms in a row. But in today’s hyper-partisan political atmosphere, the reality is that Jon is at risk of losing his seat to a MAGA Republican challenger. **And if he loses, Democrats’ odds of keeping Senate control go way down.**

Team Truth to Power

Winning in November, from the bottom of the ticket all of the way to the top, is a must.

Dear Peter,
We are very grateful for President Trump’s safety after the shocking assassination attempt. In response to this event, Homeland Security Secretary Mayorkas announced on Monday, July 15, that President Biden had **extended Secret Service protection to Robert Kennedy Jr.**
This long-overdue decision is a step towards restoring fairness and ethics in our politics.
**Hope Must Supersede the Politics of Hate and Fear**
For decades, U.S. political rhetoric has been driven by fear of the other party. Each party has accused the other of threatening to destroy the republic and democracy. Alternating power, the Democratic and Republican parties tend to govern unilaterally rather than collaboratively, fueling animosity and cycles of vitriol.
Unless we change course, the violence of this past week may be an ominous sign of what’s to come. We must embrace our disagreements without being disagreeable. **Political violence is unacceptable and must never replace a respectful, civil, and democratic culture.**
From the outset, Robert F. Kennedy Jr.’s campaign has aimed to "Heal the Divide." Kennedy has focused on the values that unite us rather than the issues that drive us apart. He has refused to bash his opponents while advocating for the restoration of an exemplary America.
Let us hope political leaders and observers recognize RFK Jr.'s wisdom.
**Secret Service Protection Brings New Visibility to Kennedy's Campaign**
With Kennedy receiving Secret Service protection, many Americans learned of his candidacy for the first time. The shifting political landscape has made voters eager for an option outside the broken two-party system. According to Gallup, 51% now identify as “independent,” and Kennedy leads this rising independent majority. Furthermore, 60% would vote for a moderate independent candidate over Biden or Trump, according to the latest Harvard Harris poll.
**Time to Act**
**Help us seize the moment.** Let's spread Kennedy's message to every voter hungry for the historic shift from division to unity, from the dark valley of hatred and distrust to the bright summit of national purpose.
**The next few months are critical to our American journey together and living up to our founding ideals.** So please donate as much as you can TODAY.
